name: Low Profile (Combat)
body:
You’ve trained against much larger foes and learned to avoid their attacks better than most.

Prerequisite(s): Combat Reflexes, Dodge.

Benefit: When fighting a creature with reach that is at least two size categories larger than you, you may ignore up to 10 ft of that creature’s reach. The creature still threatens its adjacent squares.
